title: Great app
body:
great ui and very helpful, 
however the app is buggy and crashes on me a lot. I would love to see other layout options like a grid and a timetable feature format.
author: lil dingie

title: Stagnant
body: Great app but practically unchanged since it was Wunderlist.  I like the fact it syncs between devices and is easy to share lists with people.  But the simple stuff like no new backgrounds EVER and now the inability to have usable widgets on iOS 17 is making me wonder
author: WJ 76

title: To Do or not To Do
body: I use it in tandem with my work laptop. Allows for better reminders of my day to day and month to month task at work.
author: Kyle Alex

title: Love it
body:
I love everything about this app.
From school to business to everyday list and the ability to share pretty cool. 
Just one thing it would be really nice if this lovely app was more user friendly on smart watches.
author: Dollyk1941
